dog.description_text:
This pet needs emergency placement. Please click here to go to our emergency placement page for more information.

This pet is available only through ACC New Hope partners. To adopt or foster, please complete the pre-screener form below. Inquiries sent directly to ACC will not receive a response.

Pre-Screener Form

Panda is on the at-risk list due to behavior concerns. In the care center, Panda has shown intense fearful and defensive behavior, including retreating to the back of his kennel, trembling, whale eye, hard staring, growling, baring teeth, dodging the leash, lunging, and snapping when handlers attempt to leash him. Panda continues to struggle to acclimate to the care center environment, though he has recently shown some improvement by approaching the front of his kennel and accepting treats from a familiar handler. Medically, Panda is apparently healthy

Panda was surrendered into care as a stray with a limited history. Panda was reported to have bitten his owner when they attempted to dress him in his harness. The owner was bitten on the left hand and went to urgent care for their injuries. During his stay in care, Panda has not allowed for handling or removal from the kennel. He dodges leashing and has escalated to snapping, growling, and lunging. Due to these concerns, we recommend placement in an adult-only home through a New Hope rescue partner who can provide any necessary behavior modification (force-free, positive reinforcement-based) and re-evaluate behavior in a stable home environment before placement into a permanent home.
